The v2.0 release preserves the prior v1.0.0 release manifest as the historical baseline.
Final release must contain its manifest, source, script, and project metadata.
Release collection excludes Python bytecode and development caches from the packaged artifact.
The v2.0 release records software, synthetic, public-data, and public-ephemeris evidence without converting it into a physical deployment claim.
The final release itself does not mutate external network infrastructure.
The final release does not claim or perform physical RF/hardware actuation as part of release assembly.
